name: Paddle
subtitle: Merchant of record for software
creator: Christian Owens and Harrison Rose
description: Paddle acts as the legal seller of your software, so it calculates, collects and files sales tax and VAT worldwide for you. You get checkout, subscriptions and invoicing in one fee.

languages.youWrite: Paddle.js on the frontend plus API or SDKs on the server

concepts.explanation: Paddle is the seller on the receipt.

codeSamples.label: HTML + JavaScript · Paddle.js
codeSamples.code:
<script src="https://cdn.paddle.com/paddle/v2/paddle.js"></script>
<script>
  Paddle.Initialize({ token: "live_client_side_token" });
  function buy() {
    Paddle.Checkout.open({ items: [{ priceId: "pri_123", quantity: 1 }] });
  }
</script>
<button onclick="buy()">Subscribe</button>

cons: Higher fee than Stripe's base rate

pricing.summary: No monthly fee. 5% + 50¢ per transaction, which includes sales tax and VAT handling.
